request: Let me mark important tasks and focus on those first

questions.ask: Should marking a task "important" be a simple on/off star (one level), or do you want multiple priority levels like High/Medium/Low?
questions.why: Determines whether the data model and UI need a single boolean flag or a multi-value priority field, which changes the database schema, API, and how tasks are displayed

questions.ask: When you say "focus on those first," do you want important tasks to automatically move to the top of the list, or would you rather have a separate view/filter to show only the important ones?
questions.why: Determines whether we change the default sort order of the task list or add a new filter/toggle control, which are different features

questions.ask: Once you check off (complete) an important task, should it stay pinned at the top, or drop down with the other completed tasks?
questions.why: Determines whether the sort logic treats 'important' and 'done' independently or whether completion overrides the important pinning

findings.note: Tasks table currently has only id, title, done columns — no priority/importance field exists yet, so adding this requires a schema change
GET /api/tasks returns all tasks ordered by id (insertion order); POST creates with done=0; PATCH only updates 'done'. No sorting or importance support currently exists in the API
Client renders tasks in the order the API returns them, with a checkbox per task; there is no existing UI affordance (button/icon) for marking importance
Simple dark-themed single list UI with an add-task form and a flat <ul> of tasks; no sections, filters, or priority indicators currently exist
Existing tests check seeded tasks display and that completing a task (via checkbox) survives reload — any new sorting/important feature must not break these baseline behaviors
